mapper.select: SELECT a.attendance_id, a.emp_id, a.work_date, a.check_in_time, a.check_out_time, a.work_days, a.work_hours, a.night_work_hour, e.emp_name, d.dep_name AS departmentName FROM attendance a JOIN employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN department d ON e.dep_id = d.dep_id WHERE a.emp_id = #{empId} AND a.work_date = #{date}

SELECT a.attendance_id, a.emp_id, a.work_date, a.check_in_time, e.emp_name, d.dep_name AS departmentName FROM attendance a JOIN employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN department d ON e.dep_id = d.dep_id WHERE a.emp_id = #{empId} AND a.check_in_time IS NOT NULL

SELECT a.work_date, a.check_in_time, a.check_out_time, a.emp_id, e.emp_name FROM attendance a JOIN employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE a.emp_id = #{empId} AND a.work_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND a.check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND a.check_out_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.work_date

SELECT a.emp_id, CASE WHEN a.check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND a.check_out_time IS NOT NULL THEN '근무' WHEN a.check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND a.check_out_time IS NULL THEN '지각' WHEN a.check_in_time IS NULL AND a.check_out_time IS NULL AND b.absence_type = '결근' THEN '결근' WHEN b.leave_id IS NOT NULL THEN '휴가' WHEN b.business_id IS NOT NULL THEN '출장' ELSE '기타' END AS status, b.reason, b.start_date, b.end_date FROM attendance a LEFT JOIN absence b ON a.emp_id = b.emp_id AND a.work_date = b.work_date LEFT JOIN leave c ON a.emp_id = c.emp_id AND a.work_date BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date LEFT JOIN business d ON a.emp_id = d.emp_id AND a.work_date BETWEEN d.start_date AND d.end_date WHERE a.emp_id = #{empId} AND a.work_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY a.work_date
SELECT leave_id, emp_id, start_date, end_date, leave_type, reason, is_approved FROM leave WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND start_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT SUM(DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date) + 1) FROM leave WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND is_approved = 1

SELECT a.attendance_id, a.emp_id, e.emp_name, d.dep_name, a.check_in_time, a.check_out_time, a.work_days, a.work_hours, a.night_work_hour FROM attendance a JOIN employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN department d ON e.dep_id = d.dep_id WHERE a.check_in_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT a.attendance_id, a.emp_id, e.emp_name, d.dep_name, a.check_in_time, a.check_out_time, a.work_days, a.work_hours, a.night_work_hour FROM attendance a JOIN employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN department d ON e.dep_id = d.dep_id WHERE a.emp_id = #{empId} AND a.work_date = #{date}

SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_name, d.dep_name, COALESCE(SUM(l.leave_days), 0) AS used_leave_days, (SELECT total_leave_days FROM employee WHERE emp_id = #{empId}) AS total_leave_days FROM employee e LEFT JOIN leave l ON e.emp_id = l.emp_id JOIN department d ON e.dep_id = d.dep_id WHERE e.emp_id = #{empId} GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_name, d.dep_name

SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_name, d.dep_name, COALESCE(SUM(l.leave_days), 0) AS used_leave_days, (SELECT total_leave_days FROM employee WHERE emp_id = e.emp_id) AS total_leave_days FROM employee e LEFT JOIN leave l ON e.emp_id = l.emp_id JOIN department d ON e.dep_id = d.dep_id GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_name, d.dep_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance (emp_id, work_date, check_in_time, check_out_time, work_type, absence_reason) VALUES (#{empId}, CURDATE(), #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{workType}, #{absenceReason})
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET check_in_time = #{checkInTime}, check_out_time = #{checkOutTime}, work_type = #{workType}, absence_reason = #{absenceReason} WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND work_date = CURDATE()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM attendance WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND DATE(work_date) = CURRENT_DATE()
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET check_out_time = #{now}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND DATE(work_date) = CURRENT_DATE()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM attendance WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND DATE(work_date) = CURRENT_DATE()
